subject: Post-call: long-context scouting & proposed eval artifacts
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Grant <lisa@medsync.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 05 Apr 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: long-context scouting & proposed eval artifacts

Hi Lisa — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and where I propose we start on the long-context qualification track so we can validate model fit for your clinical note workflows.

What we heard (summary):
- Primary workload: physician-authored encounter notes + attachments (avg 6–10 pages, some >30 pages).
- Key success metrics: summarization fidelity (no critical omissions), end-to-end latency under 2s per interaction for inline assistant use, and low hallucination rate on medication lists.
- Security: data stays in your VPC for the Private deployment; SOC2 evidence is required for procurement.

Recommended starting artifacts for evaluation (what we'll provide / what you provide):
- Redwood -> prompt-set-v2.md (attached): seed prompts for extractive summarization, progressive summarization, and hallucination probes.
- Redwood -> two baseline model configs to run: RW-32k-v2 (quantized q4) and RW-16k-highrec (higher-precision, slower). Both have streaming hooks and token-level cost estimates.
- MedSync -> representative sample: medsync-sample-encounters.csv (anonymized) and 4 gold summaries for fidelity checks.
- Benchmarks: we'll run Rouge-L, BLEURT, and a small human eval sweep focused on missing-critical-entities.

Proposed timeline / mutual action plan:
1) You share anonymized sample (sample CSV) and target example summaries — due Tue 4/7. (Owner: MedSync / Lisa)
2) Redwood spins up two parallel eval runs (8k warm, 32k stretched where relevant) and posts raw metrics + run logs — target Wed 4/8. (Owner: Redwood / Neha + Marissa)
3) Quick results sync to review fidelity tradeoffs and pick one model/config for a 2-week pilot — Thu 4/9. (Owner: both)

Open risks we flagged:
- Truncation behavior for extremely long notes (attachments converted to appended text) — we plan to test automatic prefix caching and chunked summarization to observe regression patterns.
- Cost sensitivity if 32k window usage is frequent — we'll provide batching & quantization recs in the run outputs.

Next steps from my side today: attaching the prompt set and a short readme for the benchmark CSV format. Marissa / Aditya: can you confirm capacity to run two parallel evals on Wed and whether we need additional compute approvals?

Lisa — if that plan works, pick a time Thu 4/9 10–11am PT for the results sync and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Lisa Grant <lisa@medsync.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 05 Apr 2026 18:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: long-context scouting & proposed eval artifacts

Neha — thanks for the crisp plan and the prompt set. A few quick clarifications before I pull the sample together: 

1) The CSV I’ll send will include separate rows per encounter and a field with concatenated attachments (OCR'd). Is that ingest format OK?
2) For the gold summaries: should those be clinician-written or can our clinical annotators produce them to speed things up?
3) For the metrics, is BLEURT configured to weight entity preservation higher? Our priority is medication & allergy fidelity.

We can hit Tue 4/7 for the sample. I’ll attach a small 20-record anonymized bundle now and follow up with a larger slice tomorrow. Attaching small-sample.csv (20 rows).

Also — procurement asked about SOC 2 evidence. Can you point me to the doc you shared earlier?

Thanks,
Lisa

--
Lisa Grant
Head of Product
MedSync
lisa@medsync.ai | 617-555-0246

Attachments: small-sample.csv (20 rows, anonymized)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 06 Apr 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: long-context scouting & proposed eval artifacts

Neha / Aditya — saw Lisa's sample come through. Quick ops check:
- Compute: we have capacity on Dedicated pool A on Wed 4/8 for two parallel runs at 32k if we accept q4 quant. If we need higher-precision for the 16k-highrec config we'll need to provision 1 additional p4d node (approval needed).
- Eval harness: I’ll wire up the BLEURT config to emphasize entity-preservation by adding a penalty term for missing token spans tagged as MEDICATION/ALLERGY. That'll give us the fidelity-focused signal Lisa wants.
- Artifacts: I pulled the prompt-set and added a small 'progressive-summarize' script to produce chunked context inputs so we can compare chunked-vs-full-window fidelity.

If Lisa's comfortable with quantized 32k as a baseline, we can run both configs within current capacity and surface cost deltas in the run logs. If not, we should approve the extra p4d by EOD Tue.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Grant <lisa@medsync.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 06 Apr 2026 09:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: long-context scouting & proposed eval artifacts

Lisa — appreciate the quick turnaround and the 20-record bundle, that's perfect to kick things off. A couple of actionable items and confirmations: 

- Format: CSV with concatenated OCR attachments is fine; our ingest doc is attached. I’ll also put the SOC2 link below.
- Gold summaries: clinician-authored are preferred for initial fidelity checks. If you can provide 10 clinician-written and 30 annotator-written, we can use both and stratify the human eval.
- BLEURT weighting: noted — Marissa will enable the entity penalty.

Mutual action items (updated):
- Lisa: drop the larger sample (anonymized 500 rows) and 10 clinician golds by Tue 4/7 EOD.
- Marissa: run parallel evals Wed 4/8, post run logs + cost comparison by EOD Wed.
- Neha: schedule Thu 4/9 10:00–10:30am PT results sync (invite sent).

SOC 2 evidence: https://redwood-inference.com/security/soc2-report (I’ve also shared the limited access Drive folder).

If anything changes on your side re: timeline, ping me and we’ll shift the slot. Otherwise, we’ll start the eval run as planned.

Thanks — Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
